<?php
class PrimitiveReadGet {
    public function __get(string $incoming) {
        echo $incoming, ":";
        if ($incoming === "null") { return null; }
        if ($incoming === "true") { return true; }
        if ($incoming === "false") { return false; }
        if ($incoming === "float") { return 1.5; }
        return "";
    }
}
$reader = new PrimitiveReadGet;
echo $reader->null === null ? "N;" : "BAD;";
$selector = "true";
echo $reader->$selector;
echo ";";
$reader->false;
echo "D;";
$selector = "float";
echo $reader->$selector;
echo ";";
$selector = "empty";
echo $reader->$selector === "" ? "E;" : "BAD;";
echo "DONE;";
